context:
Goal: the 3D copy of the Cockpit shows at a glance what waits on you (step 3d-browser-dummy, your item 277 a).
Problem (goal): the scene can group items by status or by kind, and which you see first changes what the scene is for.
Based on (read): lane notes docs/design/3d-browser-dummy-notes.md, section 1 (branch 3d-browser-dummy, 78a27bce): an item is a stack, one slab per option or step; rank sets the order on the floor, not the height.
Departs from: main — adds a 3D scene of the page's items, laid out as you pick.
Meanwhile: the lane builds on a.

options.gain: What waits on you is in front.
options.how: Open items stand on a raised floor in front. Closed items sit on a dashed shelf behind it, grey with a check.
options.label: Status floors
options.lose: Decisions and tasks mix on one floor; kind shows only by shape.

options.how: Decisions stand on one floor, tasks on another.
options.label: Kind floors
options.lose: Open and closed mix on each floor, so what waits on you is harder to spot.

title: 3D dummy: how should the scene lay out the page's items?
why: Recommended a: what still needs you stands in front, and closed work steps back.
